nodes.name: ReadAddressFile
nodes.role: read the address-change file the user names and extract the new address it states

nodes.name: ValidateAddress
nodes.role: check that the extracted content is a postal address and contains only address fields, rejecting any other requested change

nodes.name: LoadAccountProfile
nodes.role: retrieve the user's current account profile

nodes.name: ApplyAddressUpdate
nodes.role: replace only the address fields of the account profile with the validated address

nodes.name: ConfirmUpdate
nodes.role: report to the user which address fields changed and the resulting address
